# Perfetto Desktop v0.1.0

The first public release of [Perfetto Desktop](https://github.com/tooluse-labs/perfetto-desktop) — the Phase 1 MVP. A Tauri 2 macOS desktop wrapper for [Perfetto](https://github.com/google/perfetto), built by [Tooluse Labs](https://github.com/tooluse-labs). Unofficial; not affiliated with Google.

## What this is

Open Perfetto trace files in a native macOS window with the full Perfetto UI. Upstream's `com.google.PerfettoMcp` plugin is enabled by default — drop a Gemini API key into Settings and an in-app AI Chat unlocks against the loaded trace.

## What's in this release

- **macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon) DMG**, unsigned.
- Bundles upstream Perfetto UI at SHA `08617935` (v55.0).
- Default-enables `com.google.PerfettoMcp` so the **AI Chat** menu appears in the sidebar after a trace loads — no manual plugin toggle in the Plugins page.
- Works around the macOS WKWebView WASM Memory64 incompatibility by calling `ui/build.js` directly instead of `ui/run-dev-server` (which hardcodes `--only-wasm-memory64`). See [architecture §6.1](https://github.com/tooluse-labs/perfetto-desktop/blob/main/docs/design-docs/perfetto-desktop-architecture.md#61-tauri-boot-and-ui-loading).
- Service Worker bypassed (upstream's user-disabled path covers WKWebView; no patch required).
- One upstream patch lands at setup time (`patches/perfetto/0002-default-enable-perfetto-mcp.patch`); upstream Perfetto source is never modified in this repo's git history.

## What's NOT in this release

This is a Phase 1 MVP. Out of scope for v0.1.x:

- **Linux / Windows builds** — Phase 2.
- **Code signing / notarization** — first launch will trigger macOS Gatekeeper. See install steps below.
- **Fork-owned AI Chat plugin** (DeepSeek, ZAI/GLM, OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic) — Phase 2.
- **Auto-update** — Phase 3.

## Install

1. Download `Perfetto Desktop_0.1.0_aarch64.dmg` from the assets below.
2. Open the DMG, drag **Perfetto Desktop.app** to **/Applications**.
3. First launch (the app is unsigned, so macOS Gatekeeper blocks it). Pick one:
   - **Terminal** — drop the quarantine flag and launch:
     ```sh
     xattr -d com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Perfetto Desktop.app"
     open "/Applications/Perfetto Desktop.app"
     ```
   - **GUI** — double-click the app, click Cancel on the warning, then open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll to "Perfetto Desktop was blocked…", click **Open Anyway**.

To enable the AI Chat: open Perfetto's **Settings** (gear icon, sidebar), search for `Gemini Token`, paste a key from <https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey>, reload, then load a trace. The AI Chat menu appears in the sidebar's `current_trace` section.

## Headless companion

If you don't need the GUI and just want your existing MCP client (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Claude Desktop) to query a Perfetto trace, [`tooluse-labs/perfetto-mcp-rs`](https://github.com/tooluse-labs/perfetto-mcp-rs) is the recommended companion — a standalone stdio MCP server.

## Verify it works

After install, the app should:

- Boot to the Perfetto UI homepage.
- Load `.pftrace` / `.perfetto-trace` files via the sidebar's **Open trace file**.
- Render a Timeline view with Browser / Renderer / etc. tracks.
- Show **AI Chat** in the sidebar after a trace is open.

If the AI Chat menu does not appear after a trace loads, check **Plugins** in the sidebar — `com.google.PerfettoMcp` should already be toggled on.
